articles.title: What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.
articles.titleCn: 是什么让一个问题充满好奇心？在人机交互中衡量模型的求知欲
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在日常生活中越来越多地充当沟通伙伴。在这些互动中，提供有效帮助不仅需要回答问题，还需要提出恰当的问题，以揭示知识空白、假设和替代方案。在本研究中，我们将这种认知性提问称为模型好奇心，并介绍了一种基于理论的分类法，以区分以好奇心为导向的问题和通用的模型提问。在四个对话数据集中，我们发现以好奇心为导向的问题仍然罕见（占所有问题的17-28%），但与更具探索性和认知丰富性的后续用户响应相关，且在不同数据集中呈现不同模式。我们进一步开展了一项人类研究，以评估模型好奇心的实用性，发现好奇心可以鼓励探索，尤其是在建议、创意和研究情境中。这些发现对构建能够更选择性提问的大型语言模型具有重要意义，以支持更深入的探索和人类-人工智能协作。

articles.title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
articles.abstract: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.
articles.comment: 36 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23586834
articles.titleCn: 为什么结构化输出会失败？一项关于九种大型语言模型中提示强制Pydantic模式的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 需要从托管语言模型获取结构化输出的管道通常会在提示中指定一个 Pydantic 模式，验证响应，并在验证失败时重试。尽管原生结构化输出模式提供了替代方案，但应用端验证对于执行自定义约束仍然重要。然而，管道的可靠性通常仅用一个有效性率来概括，这会掩盖输出失败的原因以及哪些干预措施可能有所帮助。我们引入了一种针对模式符合性失败的细粒度分类法，以及一个确定性分类器，该分类器从模型响应和 Pydantic 验证错误中分配失败类别。我们将此框架应用于 3,997 次生成尝试，涵盖九种 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型/API 配置，使用 HotpotQA 和 FinanceBench 的问题。我们的结果表明，相似的有效性率可能掩盖不同的失败模式，并且主导的失败类别随模式约束和任务而变化。Markdown 括起来的 JSON 是最常见的失败类型：在 681 次括起来的失败中，只有 48.0% 在移除括号后通过验证，而其余的则隐藏了额外的违规，主要是字段长度违规。在探索性提示消融实验中，抑制括号的变体似乎将失败转向长度违规，但这种转变与暴露那些原本就存在的违规是一致的，这说明了总体有效性率如何掩盖失败组成的改变。我们推导出四种关于验证器、模式、重试和评估设计的工程实践，其中三种得到了我们的数据支持，而另一种关于重试反馈的实践被提出但未进行测试，并发布了分类器、完成情况和注释。

articles.title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
articles.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems achieve remarkable accuracy on academic benchmarks, yet performance drops dramatically in enterprise deployments. This gap stems from a fundamental assumption: existing approaches require complete schema documentation, but enterprise databases typically lack comprehensive documentation, featuring cryptic naming and implicit relationships. We present the first text-to-SQL framework that operates without schema documentation, instead learning database structure from historical query logs. Query logs encode implicit structural knowledge: which tables are queried together, how they join, and what columns map to business concepts. We construct a knowledge graph from parsed query patterns and introduce entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval that grounds user questions in domain terminology rather than relying solely on embedding similarity. Validated on both an industrial deployment with expert evaluation and the Beaver benchmark, our approach substantially outperforms similarity-based retrieval methods, the dominant industry approach, in both executability and answer quality. On Beaver, we achieve 95.7% execution validity compared to 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, with expert data engineers preferring our system 70% to 10% on internal deployment. Our work demonstrates that text-to-SQL can operate effectively in schema-ambiguous enterprise environments, enabling natural language database interfaces "in the wild".
articles.titleCn: 无模式文本到SQL：从查询日志中学习企业数据库结构
articles.abstractCn: 文本到SQL系统在学术基准测试中取得了显著的准确性，但在企业部署中性能却急剧下降。这种差距源于一个基本假设：现有方法需要完整的模式文档，但企业数据库通常缺乏全面文档，具有晦涩的命名和隐式关系。我们提出了首个无需模式文档的文本到SQL框架，而是从历史查询日志中学习数据库结构。查询日志编码了隐式的结构知识：哪些表被一起查询、它们如何连接以及哪些列映射到业务概念。我们从解析的查询模式中构建知识图谱，并引入实体驱动的GraphRAG检索，将用户问题锚定在领域术语中，而不是仅仅依赖嵌入相似性。在我们的工业部署（专家评估）和Beaver基准测试中验证后，我们的方法在可执行性和答案质量方面都显著优于基于相似性的检索方法，后者是行业主流方法。在Beaver测试中，我们实现了95.7%的执行有效性，而基于嵌入的检索仅为60.8%，专家数据工程师在内部部署中更喜欢我们的系统70%对10%。我们的工作证明，文本到SQL可以在模式模糊的企业环境中有效运行，实现“自然语言数据库接口”。

articles.title: HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title
articles.abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.
articles.titleCn: HerHealthGPT：基于证据的女性生殖健康对话式AI系统
articles.abstractCn: "为什么我的月经迟到了？" 有时候，最有用的回应是从另一个问题开始。然而，对话式AI系统可能会在不寻求必要背景信息或将其指导建立在可验证证据的基础上就回应不完整的健康查询。本文介绍了HerHealthGPT，这是一个基于证据的对话式AI系统，旨在解决女性生殖健康领域面临的这些挑战。HerHealthGPT集成了检索增强生成（RAG）、上下文感知澄清和来源验证，并嵌入在交互式网络界面中。该系统不会立即回应不完整的查询，而是保持对话上下文，提出有针对性的后续问题，检查过早的结论，并基于检索到的证据进行回应。我们使用90个生殖健康案例衍生的540条英文消息评估AI组件，并进行了30名成年人的原型问卷调查研究。与单独微调相比，证据检索将关注类别准确率从54.1%提高到59.3%。澄清路由器在构建目标上实现了85.6%的召回率和86.2%的特异性。在用户研究中，83.3%的参与者更喜欢带检索功能的配置，而30人中有25人认为其后续问题相关。这些结果表明，将证据检索与交互式澄清相结合，为构建更透明、上下文感知的生殖健康信息系统提供了一种有前景的方法，但进一步的临床验证仍然是必要的。

articles.title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate method that selects among CTTA methods. Empirically, we find that Select-CTTA outperforms test-time baselines and approaches the performance of models fine-tuned on shortcut-balanced data.
articles.titleCn: 反事实测试时增强用于语言模型的捷径消除
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以利用捷径，即训练数据中存在但在测试时可能不成立的关联。当关联发生变化时，这可能导致预测效果不佳。大多数现有的去除捷径的解决方案在训练时操作，需要标记的训练数据、模型权重访问以及大量的计算资源。在这里，我们研究测试时去除捷径的问题。我们提出了一系列反事实测试时增强（CTTA）方法：对于每个示例，每种方法使用一个辅助模型来生成反事实编辑，其中捷径值被改变，然后对这些编辑的LLM预测结果进行加权平均。我们证明最优的捷径不变预测器是这个CTTA系列中的一员，并描述了其权重。这些权重取决于训练分布，因此通常无法从训练好的模型和未标记的测试数据中识别。然而，我们提出了在权重可以使用训练好的LLM的标记概率获得的假设，并提出了检测这些假设违反情况的测试。我们使用这些测试开发了一种名为Select-CTTA的聚合方法，该方法在CTTA方法中进行选择。实证结果表明，Select-CTTA优于测试时基线方法，并接近在捷径平衡数据上微调的模型性能。

articles.title: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.
articles.titleCn: 当角色变得有害：以全球公民价值观对齐来引导大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被来自多元价值观和不同背景的用户使用。在尊重价值观丰富的角色时保持安全是一项独特的挑战，因为与现有安全基准中的请求不同，角色条件化请求通常并非明显恶意。因此，旨在对抗性请求的校准方法可能会忽略角色使用产生的危害，导致模型要么拒绝合法的价值观表达，要么盲目遵循不安全角色。我们构建了一个包含11k个争议性话题的数据集，这些话题与基于施瓦茨价值观调查的价值维度相匹配。通过一个迭代优化话题和角色的代理流程，我们从高度校准的商业大型语言模型中揭示并收集了有害响应，成功率超过47%。我们使用联合国教科文组织全球公民原则作为区分有效价值观表达与有害行为的最小共同基础，并引入了一种可控的校准模型，允许用户在推理时平衡角色遵循与安全。最终模型在大多数样本上比基线模型更安全且更符合角色。

articles.title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $σ$-Weighted Post-Training
articles.abstract: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $σ$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $σ$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. Intervention-Certified Amplification (ICA) gates $σ$ with paired-rollout target evidence. Frozen and online ICA reduce TIR to $13.8%$ and $11.2%$, halve residual drag, improve accuracy from $47.5%$ to $48.7%$ and $49.3%$, and transfer to held-out GSM8K without retuning.

articles.titleCn: 干预认证放大：$σ$-加权微调后的有效性关卡
articles.abstractCn: 混合后训练通常将监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）相结合，利用训练端信号来设定每个样本的平衡。这些信号表征了锚数据和策略，但无法判断强调的行为是否有助于目标任务和评估环境。这种不匹配会在其字面形式从监督中移除后重新激活并放大预训练行为。我们通过DIAA（双隐式对抗放大）进行了证明，这是一种按样本$σ$加权的SFT/RL混合方法。在其锚中移除所有字面的Python围栏后，DIAA在MATH-500提示的29%上发出了未执行的工具集成推理（TIR），是vanilla GRPO的三倍。配对干预显示，当抑制TIR时，准确率恢复10.6个百分点，SFT模仿和$σ$放大的贡献相当；在0% TIR教师锚上训练的学生在45.8%的情况下发出了TIR。干预认证放大（ICA）用配对滚出目标证据来控制$σ$。冻结和在线ICA将TIR降低到13.8%和11.2%，将残余拖拽减半，将准确率从47.5%提高到48.7%和49.3%，并在无需重新调优的情况下迁移到保留的GSM8K。

articles.title: Ranking Is Not Deciding: Benchmark Shortcuts and Operating-Point Collapse in Query-Time RAG Poisoning Defenses
articles.abstract: Query-time filters that screen each retrieved document before it reaches the generator are the dominant published defense against retrieval-augmented generation poisoning, and they report near-perfect detection on domain benchmarks. We show that this performance is predicted by how the poison set was built rather than by what the filter reads: removing a single construction cue destroys the deployed decision before it destroys the ranking. Two label-free statistics of a poison set and its clean corpus profile the cue: containment, how often the target question appears verbatim in the poison, and length overlap. PoisonedRAG's released code prepends the target question to every inserted passage. Of the 21 published defense evaluations we survey, 8 verifiably run poison built this way and 5 substitute a length cue; separately, 12 report no false-positive rate at the operating point they deploy. Deleting only that prefix from the attack authors' own passages (0.93 still retrieved for their target) takes RAGuard, a published content filter we re-implement, from AUROC 0.953 to 0.758 and its miss rate from 0.191 to 0.763. Across four corpora, four attack families and ten per-document defenses on one shared candidate set, the profile predicts where detection saturates. Padding medical poison to clean length with word-shuffled filler that carries no content takes TrustRAG's set-level stage from a miss rate of 0.000 to 0.827, and one learned scorer of ours from 0.000 to 0.986 (0.321 at a matched 5% false-positive rate) while its AUROC holds at 0.953. The ranking survives; the decision does not. A defense-aware attacker defeats our own scorer, so we claim no defense. A detection result is evidence only when it is reported with its poison set's construction profile and the false-positive rate at the threshold actually deployed; we release the script that computes the profile.
articles.titleCn: 排名并非决策：查询时RAG中毒防御中的基准捷径和操作点崩溃
articles.abstractCn: 在检索到的每份文档到达生成器之前进行筛选的查询时过滤器是针对检索增强生成中毒的主要已发表防御措施，它们在领域基准测试中报告了近完美的检测效果。我们证明这种性能是由中毒集的构建方式决定的，而不是由过滤器读取的内容决定的：移除单个构建线索会在破坏排名之前破坏部署的决策。中毒集及其干净语料库的两种无标签统计特征了该线索：包含性，即目标问题在中毒中逐字出现的频率，以及长度重叠。PoisonedRAG发布的代码将目标问题添加到每个插入的段落之前。在我们调查的21项已发表的防御评估中，有8项可验证地运行了这样构建的中毒，有5项用长度线索进行替代；另外，有12项报告在它们部署的操作点上没有误报率。从攻击作者自己的段落中仅删除该前缀（针对其目标仍检索到0.93），将我们重新实现的已发表内容过滤器RAGuard的AUROC从0.953降至0.758，其漏报率从0.191降至0.763。在四个语料库、四种攻击家族和一个共享候选集上的十个每文档防御中，该特征预测了检测饱和点。用不携带内容的词洗牌填充将医疗中毒扩展到干净长度，TrustRAG的集合级阶段漏报率从0.000升至0.827，我们学习的一个评分器从0.000升至0.986（在匹配的5%误报率下为0.321），而其AUROC保持在0.953。排名得以保留；决策却未能保留。一个有防御意识的攻击者击败了我们自己的评分器，因此我们声称没有防御。只有在中毒集的构建特征和实际部署的阈值下的误报率一同报告时，检测结果才具有证据效力；我们发布了计算该特征的脚本。

articles.title: Grounding on Request: Learning Modality Control in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: When an image and its caption disagree, can a user reliably control which one a vision-language model (VLM) follows? Accuracy alone cannot answer this question, since a model might give the correct answer from parametric knowledge without following the requested evidence. We therefore evaluate modality grounding control through conflict-preserving counterfactual interventions. Specifically, Flip measures whether an initially correct answer follows an edit to the requested modality, while Stay measures whether it remains stable when the competing modality is edited. To learn this control, we build on neologism learning by introducing new words for visual and textual grounding, training only their embeddings while keeping the pretrained model fixed. We also introduce Counterfactual Twin-Margin (CTM) supervision, which uses paired interventions to teach how answer probabilities should change when the requested evidence changes. Across three VLMs on three existing benchmarks and our multi-attribute Ground-CF benchmark, we find that learned modality words improve control over natural-language instructions. Surprisingly, a single learned embedding per modality provides strong lightweight visual control and shows little average degradation on held-out values. LoRA remains strongest overall, although its visual advantage narrows under held-out evaluation. Moreover, counterfactual supervision improves control in several settings where standard supervision is weaker. Finally, we test our method on real-world news video and find that visual control improves when the relevant evidence is made easier to access. Overall, our results show that reliable modality control requires testing not only whether an answer is correct, but whether it continues to follow edits to the modality of choice.
articles.titleCn: 基于请求的接地：视觉语言模型中的学习模态控制
articles.abstractCn: 当图像及其标题不一致时，用户能否可靠地控制视觉语言模型（VLM）遵循哪一个？仅凭准确性无法回答这个问题，因为模型可能从参数化知识中给出正确答案，而无需遵循所请求的证据。因此，我们通过冲突保留的逆事实干预来评估模态定位控制。具体而言，Flip 测量的是初始正确答案是否遵循对请求模态的编辑，而 Stay 测量的是在竞争模态被编辑时是否保持稳定。为了学习这种控制，我们基于新词学习，通过引入用于视觉和文本定位的新词，仅训练它们的嵌入，同时保持预训练模型固定。我们还引入了逆事实双边距（CTM）监督，它使用成对干预来教授当请求的证据改变时，答案概率应该如何变化。在三个现有基准上的三个VLM以及我们的多属性 Ground-CF 基准上，我们发现学习到的模态词提高了对自然语言指令的控制。令人惊讶的是，每个模态的单个学习嵌入提供了强大的轻量级视觉控制，并且在保留值上平均几乎没有退化。LoRA 仍然是最强的，尽管在保留值评估下其视觉优势有所缩小。此外，逆事实监督在标准监督较弱的情况下提高了控制。最后，我们在真实世界的新闻视频上测试了我们的方法，发现当相关证据更容易被访问时，视觉控制会得到改善。总的来说，我们的结果表明，可靠的模态控制不仅需要测试答案是否正确，还需要测试它是否持续遵循所选择模态的编辑。

articles.title: EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data
articles.abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (ARR). Code: https://github.com/BardiaKh/EdgeDeID ; models and data: https://huggingface.co/EdgeDeID
articles.titleCn: EdgeDeID：一个无需真实患者数据训练的0.6B临床去识别器
articles.abstractCn: 使用托管语言模型对临床记录进行去识别会泄露该步骤旨在保护的信息。我们提出了EdgeDeID，一个参数为0.6B的仅解码器去识别器，可在本地运行且无需真实患者文本进行训练：三个LLM教师编写合成记录，一个标注员将它们重新标注为一种规范，模型学习生成其发现的标识符的XML类型模式。在一个包含手动验证标注的100条记录的合成领域基准测试中，它达到了0.994微F1分数，并在99%的记录中未遗漏任何标识符，而八种现成系统中最强的系统仅为0.857和12%。量化后，它可在CPU上以615 MB的内存运行。在三个对监督训练的补充中，只有验证器适配器有帮助：它在0.94 AUROC下将其他系统的完整输出与不完整输出区分开来，而带有召回权重的奖励的强化学习和基于规则的后期处理层则未改变领域结果。在MIMIC ICU护理记录上，F1分数降至0.48。错误遵循了我们合成记录所缺乏的两个特性：电报风格和标识符密度低，而三个手写的上下文示例在没有标注目标数据的情况下恢复了0.08 F1分数。

articles.title: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
articles.abstract: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.
articles.titleCn: EnvLunch：将环境作为学习互动的免费午餐
articles.abstractCn: 在自主数据分析中，语言模型代理通常需要大量标注任务来学习如何与可执行环境（即数据库）进行有效交互。虽然高质量的标注任务需要大量人工工作，但可执行环境已经提供了丰富的交互结构和可验证的结果。从这个角度来看，环境本身提供了一顿免费的午餐，即一组无需人工标注的可验证任务。我们提出了EnvLunch，这是一个在下游自主强化学习之前，将环境信号转化为代理训练的预热阶段，无需人工编写的任务描述或模型生成的任务描述。EnvLunch采样有效的动作轨迹，执行它们以获得最终观察结果，并训练代理仅根据其最终观察结果来恢复功能上等效的轨迹。这种无标签的预热使模型在所有下游训练预算下平均优于基线超过9分，并且由于少量标签，基线需要8到32倍的标注示例才能达到EnvLunch模型在最小训练预算下达到的准确率。让环境本身定义任务带来的收益比让模型在相同环境中编写自己的任务更大，并且这种预热也提高了在数据分析之外的基准测试上的微调效果。因此，EnvLunch节省了标注任务，并在标注任务有限时为自主模型的微调提供了更好的起点。

articles.title: Task Format as a Factor in Adaptation: A Controlled Comparison of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning for Prompt-Safety Classification
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning a language model for classification involves many design decisions. Comparisons of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with full fine-tuning are common but often confounded, and task format is rarely studied. We compare both regimes on prompt-safety classification with a matched 400M encoder-decoder pair (Ettin) across three task formats, with up to 15 seeds per cell and pre-specified analyses. At the pre-specified learning rates, full fine-tuning leads LoRA by 2-3 pp in every architecture and format trained on the label alone. On the encoder, the gap closes once both rates are chosen by the same search. Training LoRA to write a reason after its verdict adds 4.0 pp and closes the gap, but a content-free sentence of equal length does not. Trained models score above a prompted 8B in domain but fall behind it on two of three out-of-distribution corpora, trailing by 8-23 pp on adversarial jailbreaks and flagging 27-66% of benign but harmful-looking prompts as unsafe, against the 8B's 2-3%. Together, the results suggest that the adaptation regime matters less than how each model is trained, its learning rate, and training target, and that in-domain accuracy alone is an incomplete guide to robustness.
articles.comment: 33 pages (14 pages main text, plus references and appendices), 1 figure, 18 tables
articles.titleCn: 任务格式作为适应因素：LoRA与全微调在提示安全分类中的对照比较
articles.abstractCn: 对语言模型进行分类任务的微调涉及许多设计决策。低秩适配（LoRA）与完整微调的比较很常见，但往往相互混淆，而任务格式很少被研究。我们在三种任务格式下，使用匹配的400M编码器-解码器对（Ettin）对提示安全分类任务中的两种策略进行了比较，每个单元最多使用15个种子，并进行了预先指定的分析。在预先指定的学习率下，仅在标签上训练的每种架构和格式中，完整微调都比LoRA领先2-3个基点。在编码器上，当两种学习率由同一搜索选择时，差距就会缩小。在LoRA输出其裁决后的推理后进行训练可增加4.0个基点并缩小差距，但等长的无内容句子则没有。训练模型在领域内得分高于提示的8B模型，但在三个分布外语料库中的两个上落后，在对抗性越狱测试中落后8-23个基点，并将27-66%的无害但看起来有害的提示标记为不安全，而8B模型仅为2-3%。综合来看，结果表明，与每个模型的训练方式、其学习率和训练目标相比，适配策略的重要性较低，仅靠领域内准确率并不能全面反映鲁棒性。

articles.title: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
articles.abstract: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.
articles.titleCn: 意图变化：一个人类构建的演进用户意图基准
articles.abstractCn: 在复杂任务中，语言模型代理必须根据用户不断修订的需求和优先级进行调整。我们介绍了IntentDelta，这是一个由人类构建的多轮基准，包含WebShop和TravelPlanner中的638条轨迹和3,766轮对话。每一轮对话都配对一个用户语句、累积的意图状态以及人类参考动作。这些轨迹经过交叉验证，涵盖了基于可行性和偏好变化约束和优先级的调整。我们在意图恢复和动作质量方面评估了十一位代理。TravelPlanner的平均意图恢复率为33.1%，WebShop为44.7%，平均动作得分分别为31.6%和41.0%。代理在保留早期需求以及区分软偏好和必须满足的约束方面存在困难。正确的意图恢复也不保证成功执行，这突显了将不断变化的用户意图转化为动作的挑战。

articles.title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.
articles.titleCn: MTA-Zero：通过在线问答求解器协同训练实现自改进多模态深度搜索
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已成为强大的视觉推理工具，但在需要图像定位、工具选择和整合网络证据的开放世界多步搜索任务中仍存在局限。现有方法通常构建并过滤固定的离线语料库，其问题分布无法随着目标深度搜索代理的改进而自适应调整。基于MTA-Agent的图像定位问答构建方法，我们提出了MTA-Zero，这是一个无需预计算多跳语料库的在线多模态问答协同训练框架，用于自改进的多模态深度搜索代理。从图像定位的VQA种子上下文开始，可训练的问答生成器在线检索证据并构建经过验证的多跳问题。一个独立的深度搜索解算器随后选择工具、收集证据并回答生成的问题。为使生成过程聚焦于解算器的学习前沿，我们从解算器的组内展开成功率中推导出黄金比例奖励，对所有展开解决或无一展开解决的问题给予零奖励，而优先奖励接近当前前沿的问题。我们使用GRPO独立优化这两个策略，无需共享参数或梯度。在六个多模态深度搜索基准测试中，MTA-Zero将Qwen3-VL-8B解算器的平均准确率从36.91%提升至51.58%，并在相同的代理工作流程下实现了与GPT-5相当的性能。相同的框架也使更新的Qwen3.6-27B解算器提升了10.82个百分点。这些结果表明，经过验证的在线问题生成为持续改进多模态深度搜索代理提供了特定策略的课程。

articles.title: Whispers from the Neighbors: Rethinking Caption Consensus as Inference-Time Evidence for Vision-Language Retrieval
articles.abstract: An image is rarely described only once. Retrieval benchmarks and many collections attach several captions to each picture, yet dual encoders still judge every image-caption pair in isolation. We ask what these neighboring captions contribute when a frozen encoder consults them at inference time. Fusing image similarity with similarity to an image's own captions improves text-to-image R@1 by 3.4 to 16.8 points across nine frozen encoders when the captions come from the same annotators as the queries. The gain falls to 1.9 to 7.2 points when an off-the-shelf captioner writes them, and to at most one point when they come from a different annotation source; a paraphrase-trained text encoder strengthens the text side further. A natural refinement, scoring the part of the image that the captions leave unexplained, appears to add much more under a leave-one-out evaluation. We show that this advantage arises because the correct candidate's supports are built differently from those of the negative candidates, with set size and query removal each contributing about half, and that under a fixed support index the residual reduces to a reweighting of what the captions already provide. On compositional benchmarks, the captions help by matching candidates to human descriptions of the image, without improving image-text grounding. The code is available at: https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus
articles.titleCn: 邻里的低语：重新思考标题共识作为视觉语言检索中的推理时证据
articles.abstractCn: 一幅图像很少只被描述一次。检索基准测试和许多数据集通常为每张图片附加多个标题，但双编码器仍然孤立地判断每个图像-标题对。我们探究当冻结的编码器在推理时参考这些邻近标题时，它们各自贡献了什么。当标题与查询来自同一标注者时，融合图像相似性与图像自身标题的相似性，在九个冻结编码器上使文本到图像的R@1提升了3.4到16.8分。当由现成的标题生成器编写时，提升降至1.9到7.2分，当来自不同的标注源时，提升最多为1分；经过释义训练的文本编码器进一步增强了文本方面。一个自然的改进，即评分图像中标题未解释的部分，在留一法评估下似乎能带来更多提升。我们证明这一优势源于正确候选的支持与负向候选的支持构建方式不同，集合大小和查询移除各贡献约一半，而在固定的支持索引下，残差简化为对标题已提供内容的重新加权。在组合基准测试中，标题通过将候选与图像的人类描述相匹配来提供帮助，但并未改善图像-文本的关联性。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/nhatkhangcs/clip_consensus

articles.title: One Scan is Enough: Demonstration-Free Adaptation for Language-Guided Navigation
articles.abstract: Deploying a language-guided navigation policy in a new building usually means watching it fail. Public-benchmark VLAs degrade scene by scene as layout, appearance, and language drift, and the standard fix of teleoperating fresh trajectories on site does not scale. We replace human demonstration with a single brief iPhone scan. Scan2Instruction compiles that scan into a complete training environment, automatically synthesizing executable navigation episodes with grounded instructions. PRPT-KS then adapts the policy through a closed-form Pareto utility read directly off the reconstructed scene, with no learned critic and no human labels. Across five real environments, the two designs together drive our RealNav to an 85% real-robot success rate, compared with 49% for a RealNav baseline post-trained on human demonstrations, and still achieve 82% in unscanned regions of the same buildings, compared with 41% for the same baseline. Our work turns demonstration-free scene adaptation for language-guided navigation from an aspiration into a working reality.
articles.titleCn: 一次扫描足矣：无需演示的语言引导导航自适应方法
articles.abstractCn: 在新建建筑中部署语言引导导航策略通常意味着要眼睁睁看着它失败。公共基准VLAs随着布局、外观和语言的漂移而逐场景退化，而现场远程操控新轨迹的标准修复方法无法扩展。我们用一次简短的iPhone扫描替代人工演示。Scan2Instruction将这次扫描编译成一个完整的训练环境，自动合成带有基础指令的可执行导航场景。PRPT-KS随后通过重建场景直接读取的闭式Pareto效用来适应策略，无需学习型评价器，也无需人工标签。在五个真实环境中，这两种设计共同将我们的RealNav推动到85%的实机器人成功率，相比之下，在经过人工演示后训练的RealNav基线仅为49%，而在我方基线中，在未扫描的同一建筑区域仍能达到82%。我们的工作将语言引导导航的无演示场景适应从一种愿景变成了现实。

articles.title: TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.
articles.titleCn: TriageRAG：一种具有故障感知的自训练方法，用于将检索增强语言模型适应专业领域
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够根据检索到的证据回答知识密集型问题，但在只有无标签语料库的情况下，将通用RAG系统适配到医学等特定领域十分困难。SimRAG等自训练方法通过让LLM从领域文本中生成自己的问答对，并在通过回合一致性过滤器筛选后的对上进行微调来解决这个问题。我们观察到这些方法对每个保留的示例都同等对待：它们从不询问学生是否已经知道答案，是否已从检索到的上下文中正确提取答案，或者是否失败——如果失败，则不会判断是读者的问题还是检索器的问题。为应对此问题，我们提出了TriageRAG，这是一种故障感知的自训练方法，它对每个自生成的问答对分别有和没有检索上下文地提问学生，将其分为四个类别（已知、已解决、上下文失败、检索失败），并将每个类别路由到解决该问题的训练信号，包括一个参数路由，该路由教导读者在检索失败时如何回答。探测成本较低且每轮重复进行，因此训练混合物跟随学生，并且分诊直方图也充当领域差距的无标签诊断工具。在涵盖三个领域的11个数据集上使用Qwen3-4B主干，以及在CS-Bench上使用Qwen3-8B进行的实验表明，TriageRAG比预算匹配的SimRAG提高了1.2-6.4分，并且是唯一在检索损害基础模型的情况下始终恢复闭卷水平的方法。一次消融实验确定了机制：回合过滤移除了所有缺乏证据的训练上下文，而从未见过此类上下文的读者学会了过度信任噪声检索。

articles.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS
articles.abstract: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner's checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.
articles.titleCn: 《搭便车者指南：超越大语言模型的快速决策系统1模型》
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在推理和生成方面表现出色，但它们自回归、逐个token的推理方式导致其速度不必要地慢、成本高昂，并且难以满足现代AI系统在亚秒级延迟下对大量常规决策（如路由、门控、评分、分类）的需求。一个日益增长的研究类别正致力于解决这一差距：系统1决策模型，这是一种将输入直接映射到单次前向传递中生成的类型化、结构化决策的架构。本指南提供了对该领域的全面、面向实践者的处理。我们提出了一个涵盖基于编码器的分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比决策模型和提取模型的五大家族分类法，并深入探讨了每个家族的架构、训练方法和部署权衡。一个核心主题是校准：我们发展了恰当评分规则的理论，分析了校准决策的强化学习（RLCD），并考察了最近发现的现象，包括IIA（独立性不假设）违反、序数尺度偏差以及分布偏移下的少样本校准。在集成方面，我们描述了系统1模型如何在代理工作流和系统1+系统2级联中作为决策基础设施发挥作用，这些级联根据校准的置信度在快速和慢速模型之间进行路由。本指南涵盖了18个应用领域，绘制了快速增长的开放源代码生态系统（几周内就有超过70个模型复现），提供了全程可运行的代码，并包括一个实践者检查清单、一个开放源代码模型动物园以及22个带详细答案的自我评估问题。全书包含190个参考文献，旨在成为在快速决策、校准和生产AI系统交叉领域工作的研究人员和工程师的统一入口。

articles.title: StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue
articles.abstract: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe's cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.
articles.titleCn: 州级：教导语言模型追踪并遵守多轮对话中不断变化的约束
articles.abstractCn: 对话式助手的使用者很少一开始就陈述所有需求：他们会添加约束、修改约束、撤回约束、离题，然后返回。指令调优的大型语言模型（LLM）在这方面存在两个问题：随着对话轮次的增加，主动约束不再被遵守（持久性失效），而撤回的约束仍然被执行（复发）。我们所知唯一现有的修复方法是一个外部账本，它在每一轮中重新注入编译后的规范。我们提出了StateWise，一种自我改进的方法，它教会单个LLM维护自己的可修订约束状态，这是一个带有关注标记的典型状态，用于撤回的约束，因此持久性和复发可以通过可执行的检查器来衡量，而真实状态可以免费编译。StateWise在两个互补技能上微调LLM，将对话总结为其约束状态，并根据该状态进行响应，然后在自己的轨迹上进行自我训练，只保留通过编译状态精确往返检查的轮次。这教会了7-8B模型几乎完美地跟踪状态，但出乎意料的是，它们并不遵守它：在Llama-3.1-8B上，每个监督变体的大致复发率翻了一番。因此，我们在自我生成的复发对比阶段添加了一个偏好阶段，被拒绝的响应执行了被撤回的规则，而选择的响应通过了往返检查。在两个保留约束家族和未见过的措辞的主干上，StateWise相对于监督自我训练将复发降低了8-22点，相对于主干将对话成功率提高了8-19点，并在复发方面击败了没有推理时间脚手架的编译账本基线。我们还描述了该配方在通用指令遵循基准上的成本，并研究了权重插值作为一种缓解措施。

articles.title: RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. The streaming student is fine-tuned on the mixture in a single pass. Across customer-service calls with gold roles and earnings calls with silver roles, RoleHear attributes roles accurately while preserving transcription quality and narrowing the gap to the offline teacher.
articles.titleCn: RoleHear：半监督角色标注流式语音识别的伪标签方法
articles.abstractCn: 流式自动语音识别在低延迟下转录，但生成的词流没有归属信息，而客服分析等实时应用需要每个词都关联到说话人角色。角色归属通常是一个独立阶段，要么是针对词流对齐的离线或流式说话人分割模型，要么是应用于转录文本的基于文本的大语言模型，但用于训练的角色标签稀缺。我们提出了RoleHear，一个半监督流程，使单个缓存感知流式转换器通过轻量级词汇内角色标记直接发出角色：一个快速转换边界标记，随后几词后跟一个每个角色的标记。一个离线转换器教师被微调成一个角色归属识别器，重新标记未标记的音频，一个多模态大语言模型在没有金标注时提供银色角色标签。流式学生在一个单次遍历中在混合数据上进行微调。在具有金角色的客服通话和具有银角色的收益通话中，RoleHear在保持转录质量的同时准确归属角色，并缩小与离线教师之间的差距。

articles.title: Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems
articles.abstract: As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. RATE provides a streamlined error taxonomy, expanded severity ratings, and multidimensional scoring balancing accuracy and fluency, facilitating deeper analysis of MT outputs. Our analysis, powered by this expert dataset, reveals that state-of-the-art MT systems may have surpassed human translations in accuracy while still lagging in fluency - a critical distinction obscured by existing accuracy-biased metrics. Our findings highlight that advancing MT evaluation requires not only better protocols but crucially, high-quality annotations from skilled linguists.
articles.comment: Published in Findings of EMNLP 2025. 17 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/wmt24-en-ru-rate
articles.titleCn: 精炼翻译评估：重新思考机器翻译评估在人类水平系统时代
articles.abstractCn: 随着机器翻译系统接近人类水平质量，传统的评估方法难以检测细微的翻译错误。我们对当前黄金标准方法（MQM和ESA）的局限性进行了批判性审视，包括标注者专业水平差异导致的不一致性、分类复杂性过高、严重程度粒度粗糙、准确性优先于流畅性以及时间限制等问题。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个高质量数据集，其中包含由专业语言学家对WMT24英俄翻译进行的人类评估。我们表明，不受时间压力的专业评估结果与标准评估结果存在显著差异。为使这些专家能够进行一致且丰富的标注，我们开发了RATE（精炼翻译评估）协议。RATE提供了一种简化的错误分类体系、扩展的严重程度评分以及平衡准确性和流畅性的多维评分，从而促进对机器翻译输出的深度分析。我们的分析，基于这个专家数据集，揭示出最先进的机器翻译系统可能在准确性上已经超越人类翻译，但在流畅性方面仍存在差距——这一关键区别被现有的准确性偏向指标所掩盖。我们的研究结果表明，推进机器翻译评估不仅需要更好的协议，而且至关重要的是，需要来自熟练语言学家的高质量标注。

articles.title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
articles.abstract: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 1 figure. Dataset and prompts: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yandex/orbit-mt-eval
articles.titleCn: 超越提示：基于LLM的机器翻译评估器的系统研究
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型的评估器已迅速成为机器翻译评估的标准工具，但其行为塑造的设计选择仍缺乏深入理解。我们系统性地研究了指令设计、少量样本演示、骨干模型选择和多步骤工作流程如何影响片段级和基于排序的机器翻译评估。我们在WMT24和WMT25英语-俄语翻译任务上收集了新的专家RATE标注，并在五个额外的语言对上对MQM和ESA标注的基准数据进行了迁移验证。实验揭示了四个稳健的发现：指令结构塑造评估器行为，高质量演示比数量更重要，前沿骨干展现出不同的评估器特征（召回导向、精确度导向或排序导向），融合不同骨干的输出优于单一评估器多调用设置。尽管评估器设计暴露了巨大的组合空间，但多个发现的 设计原则在不同标注协议和语言对间表现出一致的迁移性。我们将这些发现综合为ORBIT系列，这是一家人工智能驱动的机器翻译评估器。我们最强的配置在错误片段检测和准确性与流畅性排序上达到了专家级性能，成本仅为专家人工标注的约1/20。

articles.title: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.
articles.comment: 20 pages (10 pages of main text, plus references and appendix). Accepted at EVAL4SD 2026. To appear in the ACL Anthology
articles.titleCn: 由大型语言模型介导的ADHD自我诊断中的性别关联
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于医疗自我诊断。然而，人口统计学线索如何塑造这些交互中的输出方式仍然知之甚少。这对于像注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）这样的诊断尤其重要，因为其中持续存在的性别差异并不完全符合临床证据。我们调整了上下文关联测试（CAT），以评估GPT-4o在零样本、自我诊断设置中是否对性别化的ADHD关联做出响应。我们发现，明确的提示始终会增强某些ADHD亚型的关联，而隐含的提示则产生近似代理对齐的分布。这些差异表明，明确的群体统计线索可能会激活纠正偏见而非消除偏见的机制，而隐含的线索似乎反映了模型的默认行为。我们的结果表明，评估LLM介导的自我诊断中的性别偏见需要仔细关注模型编码的群体统计关联。

articles.title: Embedding-Based Educational Taxonomies
articles.abstract: Educational taxonomies organize educational content, such as exercise problems, into concepts, which are also called skills or knowledge components. These taxonomies define learning objectives in educational applications such as intelligent tutoring systems. Developed through human expertise and iterative refinement, they also provide fundamental structure for curricula, assessment, and models of student learning. Recent advances in semantic text embeddings make it possible to construct alternative educational taxonomies computationally from the content itself. In this paper, we investigate this possibility by clustering embeddings of math questions to construct embedding-based educational taxonomies. We compare these taxonomies with the existing Common Core State Standards (CCSS)-based knowledge-component taxonomies in two ASSISTments datasets and evaluate their utility in Deep Knowledge Tracing, a downstream task that relies on taxonomic mappings of questions to knowledge components. The embedding-based taxonomies exhibit substantial but incomplete correspondence with the existing taxonomies, revealing both preserved and alternative organizations of educational content. When used for knowledge tracing, they improve predictive performance by approximately 3-5 AUC percentage points. These results demonstrate the potential of semantic embeddings for automatically constructing educational taxonomies that both recover structure present in human-developed taxonomies and provide useful alternative representations for downstream educational modeling.
articles.titleCn: 基于嵌入的教育分类体系
articles.abstractCn: 教育分类法将教育内容，如练习题，组织成概念，这些概念也被称为技能或知识组件。这些分类法定义了教育应用（如智能辅导系统）中的学习目标。它们通过人类专业知识和迭代完善而发展，并为课程、评估和学生学习模型提供了基本结构。语义文本嵌入的最新进展使得能够从内容本身计算地构建替代的教育分类法。在本文中，我们通过聚类数学问题的嵌入来构建基于嵌入的教育分类法，并研究这种可能性。我们将这些分类法与现有的基于共同核心州标准（CCSS）的知识组件分类法在两个ASSISTments数据集中进行比较，并评估它们在深度知识追踪（一个依赖于问题到知识组件分类映射的下游任务）中的效用。基于嵌入的分类法与现有分类法存在大量但不完全的对应关系，揭示了教育内容既被保留又被重新组织的组织方式。当用于知识追踪时，它们将预测性能提高了约3-5个AUC百分点。这些结果表明，语义嵌入在自动构建教育分类法方面的潜力，这些分类法既能恢复人类开发分类法中存在的结构，又能为下游教育建模提供有用的替代表示。

articles.title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
articles.abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.
articles.comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at https://github.com/nadunnr/PathKGen
articles.titleCn: PathKGen：病理知识辅助的可解释性组织病理学多模态语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 全切片图像（WSI）分析是数字病理学中癌症临床诊断的基本方法。近年来，多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的进步使得最先进的（SOTA）自动化病理学报告生成成为可能。然而，MLLM完全通过其神经参数中编码的分布进行推理，限制了它们在给定模型规模下所能包含的知识和推理逻辑量。它们的黑盒推理给人类解释中间推理带来了另一项挑战。我们通过利用知识图谱为MLLM注入外部结构化知识以供推理，同时使这一推理组件可视化，来解决这些问题。知识图谱能够部分外部化医学知识的包含，这是在病理学报告生成领域中尚未充分探索的领域。我们介绍了PathKGen，这是一种用于病理学报告生成的知识图谱辅助MLLM。PathKGen有两个主要分支：（1）一个视觉路径，使用病理学基础模型学习MLLM的视觉标记输入；（2）一个知识路径，通过查询病理学特定知识图谱来提取WSI的关键形态学特征，从而学习知识标记输入。在WSI-Bench数据集上的综合评估表明，PathKGen超越了以往SOTA方法，同时以视觉直观的图形式揭示了诊断推理。由于其模块化设计，所提出的知识路径与视觉对齐的MLLM互补，并且可以通过整理特定领域的知识图谱来生成知识标记，从而扩展到其他应用。

articles.title: Meta-CLIP: Metadata-Conditioned Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Disease Inference
articles.abstract: Medical vision--language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. We introduce Meta-CLIP, a metadata-conditioned contrastive framework that uses acquisition similarity to reweight cross-modal negatives during pretraining. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image--text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95\% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96--1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision--language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.
articles.titleCn: 元CLIP：元数据条件对比学习用于零样本疾病推理
articles.abstractCn: 医学视觉——语言预训练从配对图像和放射科报告中学习可迁移的表示，但扫描仪和采集协议的差异可能会损害迁移性。现有方法主要丰富临床语义，而DICOM头中的结构化采集信息未被充分利用。我们引入了Meta-CLIP，这是一个元数据条件对比框架，它使用采集相似性在预训练期间重新加权跨模态负样本。数值和分类DICOM字段的核定义了一个有界的成对边际。这个边际增加了采集相似负样本的贡献，强调了共享成像条件的研究之间的差异。该核在图像-文本优化期间保持固定，推理遵循标准的双编码器架构，无需元数据。我们在胸部X光和体积胸部CT上通过零样本分类、外观扰动、定位和表示分析评估了Meta-CLIP。在CT-RATE上，Meta-CLIP比CT-CLIP提高了1.41个点的宏观AUROC，95%配对引导置信区间为0.96-1.85个点。它还在五个CXR基准中的四个上实现了最高的宏观AUROC。一项探索性的BrgSA评估将分析扩展到另一个CT主干。这些发现支持采集元数据作为医学视觉-语言学习的实用训练时先验。代码将在发表时公开。

articles.title: Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. We formulate estimation as an inverse-game problem, jointly inferring preferences and behavioral parameters from observed choices. We evaluate PBM in three social dilemmas that expose conflicting motives: a Public Goods Game, a Collective-Risk Dilemma, and a Common-Pool Resource dilemma. We find that while preferences estimated from established behavioral economic elicitation instruments do not consistently predict behavior in these dilemmas, models fitted in one dilemma retain predictive value in others, suggesting that inferred preferences capture meaningful aspects of LLM decision-making that elicitation instruments may miss. Finally, we assess alignment with persona instructions, finding that inferred preferences broadly reflect intended priorities with specific divergences across dimensions, LLMs, and games being identified by our approach. Our methodology provides a framework for studying how consistently LLM preferences explain behavior, assessing alignment with intended priorities, and revealing trade-offs and behavioral patterns that standard elicitation may miss.
articles.titleCn: 在大型语言模型中联合建模偏好与不完美决策
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在标准诱导任务中表达的偏好能否预测其策略行为？与人类和其他人工智能系统交互的LLM代理面临潜在冲突的目标，如个体福祉、群体福祉和环境问题。先前研究通过行为经济学和心理诱导或策略博弈来表征LLM的偏好，但很少测试不同情境下的行为一致性以及在其他策略环境中的预测能力。这需要建模竞争性目标如何共同塑造行为，而现有方法通常孤立地测量偏好维度。基于效用理论，我们引入了偏好-行为模型（PBM），该模型结合了偏好表示与捕捉不完全效用最大化的机制。我们将估计问题表述为逆博弈问题，从观察到的选择中联合推断偏好和行为参数。我们在三个暴露出冲突动机的社会困境中评估PBM：公共物品博弈、集体风险困境和共同池资源困境。我们发现，虽然通过既定的行为经济学诱导工具估计的偏好在这些困境中并不一致地预测行为，但在一个困境中拟合的模型在其他困境中仍保持预测价值，这表明推断的偏好捕捉了LLM决策中有意义方面，而这些方面可能被诱导工具所忽略。最后，我们评估了与角色指令的一致性，发现推断的偏好广泛反映了预期的优先事项，但在维度、LLM和博弈之间存在特定差异，我们的方法识别了这些差异。我们的方法论为研究LLM偏好解释行为的一致性、评估与预期优先事项的一致性以及揭示标准诱导可能忽略的权衡和行为模式提供了一个框架。

articles.title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
articles.abstract: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.
articles.titleCn: 预览：通过预处理视图和线索增强GUI基础
articles.abstractCn: 图形界面定位需要在大杂烩截图中定位小控件，并识别自然语言指令所指的控件。裁剪和放大可以暴露局部细节，但生成的图像可能仍然对目标意图存在模糊性。我们提出了PreView，一个辅助预处理工具，可以在不进一步训练现有定位模型的情况下改进其输入。PreView准备两种互补类型的输入特征：用于定位的任务相关视图和用于目标理解的候选特定线索。一个训练好的轻量级辅助模型预测并细化中心位置，将截图裁剪为局部视图，并对该视图进行放大以用于放大定位。它还准备一个视觉线索（即带有位置提示的红色圆圈标记）和一个描述候选身份或功能的文本线索。冻结的定位模型使用准备好的输入来预测最终点击位置。在五个基准测试中，PreView在不进一步训练这些定位模型的情况下，提高了Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B和Qwen3-VL-4B的平均定位准确率。广泛的分析考察了视图和线索的贡献、中心细化以及视觉输入预算。

articles.title: A Model-Theoretic Formalization of AlKhwaremis ilm alfaraid
articles.abstract: This paper presents a model theoretic and computational formalization of AlKhwarizmis treatment of inheritance within the framework of Computational Fiqh. We first show that every inheritance configuration in a specified class is representable as a finite system of rational linear equalities and inequalities, and that such systems are decided exactly by Fourier Motzkin elimination over Q. We then define the fixed dimensional inheritance structure Vd with distinguished claimant coordinates, and prove that every admissible rational linear coordinate realization is isomorphic to Vd, this establishes the algebraic representation as canonical within that class. The complete first order theory Td of Vd is shown to be complete by construction and is explicitly distinguished from the decidability of the inheritance relevant fragment. The methodological principle is then related to a broader formalization of closed Fiqh domains via exhaustive case generation, Horn clause axiomatization, and terminating deduction, yielding domain relative computational completeness.
articles.titleCn: 阿尔·花拉子米的《算术原理》的模型理论形式化
articles.abstractCn: 本文在计算法学框架下，对阿尔·花拉子米的继承处理进行了模型理论和计算层面的形式化。我们首先证明，特定类中的任意继承配置均可表示为有限个有理线性等式与不等式系统，且此类系统可由Q上的傅里叶-莫特肯消元法精确判定。随后，我们定义了具有特定受益人坐标的固定维继承结构Vd，并证明任意可接受的理性线性坐标实现均与Vd同构，从而确立了该类中的代数表示为典范形式。通过构造证明Vd的一阶完全理论Td完备性，并明确区分其与继承相关片段的可判定性。该方法论原则通过穷尽性案例生成、洪氏子句公理化及终止性演绎，将封闭性法学领域的形式化扩展，最终实现领域相对的计算完备性。

articles.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
articles.abstract: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.
articles.titleCn: RSI竞技场：通过人类反馈实现递归自我改进
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能代理能否自主训练有用的语言模型，并利用用户反馈来改进它们？我们介绍了RSI Arena，这是一个分为两个阶段的研究，旨在实现递归自我改进。十个前沿模型作为训练代理，每个模型都从NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base开始。在为期六天的第一阶段中，每个代理拥有1000 GPU小时和300美元的API信用额度，在共享的64 GPU集群上独立选择数据、实施训练流程并选择检查点。我们通过20个基准测试和盲法人工评估来评估它们的模型。所有十个代理都生成了可用的助手，其中最强的模型由GPT-6 Astra训练，在12个能力基准测试中，其关闭了基础模型到Instruct模型的中位数差距76%。在统计调整答案长度和格式后，其人工偏好评分也接近NVIDIA Instruct。在第二阶段，每个代理收到涉及其第一阶段模型的比较记录和投票，并被给予额外的三天时间进行进一步训练。使用NVIDIA Instruct作为两个评估轮次的共同参考，我们观察到十个模型中有八个在风格调整后的相对评分中从第一阶段到第二阶段有所改进。我们表明基准测试的收益是适度的，与偏好收益之间没有明显的联系，而一些代理鼓励更长的响应，并且一个模型在StrongREJECT上表现出有害的合规性增加。RSI Arena提供了一个可审计的环境，用于研究人类反馈如何指导自主模型开发。它朝着递归自我改进与人反馈（RSIHF）迈进了一步，在这个过程中，人们帮助定义了他们使用的AI系统的改进意义。

articles.title: Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities
articles.abstract: Hallucination detection is increasingly important for evaluating and deploying large language models. However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings. We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated. Using this framework, we analyze how benchmark construction, annotation, and evaluation choices shape the underlying prediction task, and relate detector mechanisms and assumptions to the settings in which their performance is measured. We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric. Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.
articles.titleCn: 菌丝体：跨来源、类型和粒度的幻觉检测元研究
articles.abstractCn: 幻觉检测对于评估和部署大型语言模型正变得越来越重要。然而，现有方法通常在不同的基准上进行比较，而这些基准在定义和衡量幻觉方面存在显著差异，导致在不同环境下报告的分数难以解读。我们将幻觉检测研究为一个受基准条件制约的测量问题，并将现有基准沿三个维度进行组织：来源，描述模型输出和证据条件是如何获得的；类型，捕捉基准标签所代表的真实性和忠实性失败；粒度，指定幻觉标注、预测和评估的单位。基于这一框架，我们分析了基准构建、标注和评估选择如何塑造底层的预测任务，并将检测机制和假设与它们性能被测量的环境联系起来。我们还考察了片段级评估，其中标注边界的差异可能显著影响报告结果，并提出了片段覆盖率F1作为补充的基于包含的指标。我们的分析阐明了检测分数所捕捉的内容，突出了跨基准比较的局限性，并推动了在基准条件下进行更明确的泛化评估。

articles.title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
articles.abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.
articles.titleCn: 言语是心智的发声：通过心智引导的证据推理从社交痕迹中估计抑郁严重程度
articles.abstractCn: 抑郁症严重程度评估对于心理健康评估和干预至关重要，然而传统方法依赖于临床访谈或自我报告问卷，需要用户的主动参与。随着在线社交媒体的广泛使用，用户留下了丰富的社交痕迹，这些痕迹可能反映其心理状态，从而推动了基于社交媒体的抑郁症严重程度评估任务。现有工作已从基于文本特征的分类发展到基于大型语言模型（LLM）的标准化量表项目问卷完成，但仍然在用户特定心理先验建模、多样化语义检索以及心理证据的细粒度推理方面存在不足。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了UMer，一个基于社交痕迹的抑郁症严重程度评估的用户特定心理证据推理框架。UMer首先从历史社交痕迹中提炼用户特定的心理先验，以捕捉用户的心理倾向、行为模式和自我表达风格。然后，它执行量表引导的多查询检索，从与项目相关的帖子中构建证据记忆。最后，它进行从粗到细的证据感知推理，以区分直接和间接证据，并具有可解释的推理逻辑预测项目级分数。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，UMer不仅实现了优于现有基线的竞争性性能，还提供了基于证据的可解释性，并泛化到其他基于量表的任务。

articles.title: When the Weakest Language Keeps Moving: ARMOR-DP for Multilingual BabyLM
articles.abstract: Multilingual BabyLM systems usually fix language sampling proportions even though the weakest language can change during training. We present ARMOR-DP, a modular framework that diagnoses imbalance arising from representation, exposure, capacity, and objective pressure, and uses per-language validation loss to update sampling. Controlled experiments show that equal character budgets create a severe representation artifact for Chinese; byte-level encoding removes much of it, while static Chinese protection can subsequently make English the weakest language. The dynamic controller tracks these transitions and achieves a better score--balance tradeoff than fixed protection. On official evaluation, curriculum-dynamic checkpoints outperform a matched static Chinese-protective baseline while using fewer Chinese epochs; scaling capacity yields the strongest internal ARMOR-DP system. These results support a simple conclusion: multilingual weakness is a training-time state rather than a fixed property of a language. ARMOR-DP therefore separates diagnosis from intervention, allowing protection to follow the current bottleneck instead of a predetermined language label.
articles.comment: Accepted to the BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 当最弱的语言持续移动：面向多语言BabyLM的ARMOR-DP
articles.abstractCn: 多语言BabyLM系统通常在训练过程中固定语言采样比例，即便最弱的语言可能会发生变化。我们提出了ARMOR-DP，一个模块化框架，用于诊断由表示、接触、容量和目标压力引起的失衡问题，并使用每语言验证损失来更新采样。受控实验表明，相等的字符预算对中文产生了严重的表示伪影；字节级编码消除了其中大部分，而静态中文保护随后可能使英语成为最弱的语言。动态控制器跟踪这些转换，并在平衡权衡方面取得了比固定保护更好的分数。在官方评估中，课程动态检查点在使用更少中文轮次的情况下优于匹配的静态中文保护基线；而扩展容量产生了最强的内部ARMOR-DP系统。这些结果支持一个简单的结论：多语言弱点是训练过程中的状态，而非语言的固有属性。因此，ARMOR-DP将诊断与干预分离，允许保护跟随当前瓶颈而非预设的语言标签。

articles.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
articles.abstract: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.
articles.titleCn: Trajectory2Gym：基于决策的工具使用智能体组合交互合成
articles.abstractCn: 成功的工具使用轨迹并不必然具有有用的监督作用。即使成功的交互也可能低估多步依赖关系，或包含在决策时刻对智能体可见信息无法提供合理依据的操作。我们识别出有效轨迹监督的两个耦合要求：组合覆盖性，以确保重要的观察-操作依赖关系得到体现；决策基础性，以确保每个受监督的操作都由智能体可见的交互历史所支持。我们引入了Trajectory2Gym，该系统围绕欠支持的组合结构构建可执行交互，并仅从其实际执行中的基础性决策中提取监督信息。结构支持选择分配由此产生的经验，而父归一化的监督微调则将语义交互作为训练权重的单位。这重新定义了轨迹生成，将其视为有意构建可学习交互经验的主动过程，而非成功轨迹的收集。在五个Qwen3规模上，Trajectory2Gym在所有测试规模上均提升了Tau1、Tau2和BFCL指标，使等权重三基准均值提升了16.9-29.8个百分点。这些提升在状态化及多轮交互中最为显著，其中后续决策依赖于早期观察和反馈。我们的结果表明，扩展工具使用智能体的规模不仅依赖于收集更多成功的轨迹，更在于构建其依赖关系得到体现且决策可从智能体可见历史中学习的交互。

articles.title: SEDATE: Do Large Language Models Share an Aggression Circuit Across Languages?
articles.abstract: As the applications of AI continue to expand across various multimodal and multilingual domains, ensuring safe and responsible deployment of these systems has become an important concern. A wide-range of interventions have been proposed to make AI responses safer and more reliable. They often incur substantial computational or annotation costs, or cannot be extended to multilingual settings. In this work, we propose Selective Detection And Targeted Editing (SEDATE), a training-free approach based on detect-edit-verify strategy. SEDATE first detects the responsible neurons, edits them as and when necessary and finally verifies the model responses; all without any additional model training. We evaluate SEDATE across 7 languages and 4 model families. We further evaluate its effectiveness across 4 out-of-distribution languages and 4 additional datasets. We show that SEDATE achieves substantially superior safety scores across all languages and models over the best-performing baseline while retaining the general capabilities and incurring negligible overhead. Our results are robust, with the trends remaining similar for out-of-distribution languages and datasets.
articles.titleCn: SEDATE：大型语言模型是否跨语言共享一个攻击回路？
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能应用在多种模态和多语言领域的不断扩展，确保这些系统的安全与负责任部署已成为一个重要关注点。人们提出了多种干预措施来提高人工智能响应的安全性和可靠性，但这些措施往往伴随着巨大的计算成本或标注成本，或者无法扩展到多语言环境。在这项工作中，我们提出了选择性检测与针对性编辑（SEDATE）方法，这是一种基于检测-编辑-验证策略的无训练方法。SEDATE首先检测负责的神经元，根据需要对其进行编辑，并最终验证模型响应，所有这些步骤均无需额外的模型训练。我们在7种语言和4个模型系列上评估了SEDATE，并进一步在4种分布外语言和4个附加数据集上评估了其有效性。结果表明，SEDATE在所有语言和模型上均显著优于最佳基线，同时保留了通用能力并产生了可忽略的开销。我们的结果具有鲁棒性，分布外语言和数据集的趋势保持相似。

articles.title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
articles.abstract: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at https://skillshift-bench.github.io/.
