articles.titleCn: SkillShift-Bench：在环境演化下对网络代理的技能学习进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 技能学习使网络智能体能够在长期交互任务中复用先验经验。然而，学习到的技能通常在封闭环境中进行评估，忽略了现实世界网络部署中调用上下文、感知基础和执行可行性的持续变化。为此，我们引入SkillShift-Bench，这是首个用于在受控开放环境变化下评估技能学习的基准。SkillShift-Bench在三个自托管网络系统中模拟上下文变化、感知变化和执行变化，并通过涵盖任务成功率、交互成本、技能使用和技能失败的诊断来评估智能体。综合实验揭示了在受控变化下系统性的鲁棒性退化，表现为成功率降低、交互成本升高和技能失败频率增加，其中执行变化施加了最大压力。我们进一步将变化技能执行表述为非平稳局部可执行性问题，并提供了动态遗憾分析和实用测试时适应方法，证明了无需重新学习技能库即可提升学习技能执行可行性的可行性。代码、任务、环境、文档和排行榜可在https://skillshift-bench.github.io/获取。

articles.title: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
articles.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee's logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)
articles.titleCn: 隐式信念作为可扩展的战略性说服过程奖励
articles.abstractCn: 训练大型语言模型（LLM）用于多轮策略性说服面临两个相互关联的障碍：（i）基于心理学原理的说服对象真实模拟，（ii）在策略对话中进行信用分配所需的密集、忠实监督。结果仅奖励稀疏且无法提供哪些对话步骤驱动了成功的线索，而LLM-裁判过程奖励则成本高昂且与底层交互动态脱节。我们通过一个统一框架解决这两个挑战。首先，我们引入PersuArena，一个生成真实、非单调轨迹的说服模拟环境。其次，基于该环境，我们提出了通过在线信念引出进行相对策略优化的过程奖励（Probe-RPO），这是一个将说服对象内部状态转化为密集过程奖励的在线强化学习框架。每一轮，从冻结的说服对象 logits 中读取三个内省探测，产生一个多维度的奖励信号，该信号与说服动态紧密对齐。在涵盖医疗保健、金融咨询、职场管理、教育和人际关系等多个领域的 PersuArena 大规模实验中，我们证明我们的 Probe-RPO 实现了 52.5% 的完全接受率，相比之下，最强的 GRPO 消融实验为 35.8%，而最佳现成 LLM 为 25.8%。我们还对说服对象模型的泛化以及跨对话的说服动态进行了全面分析。我们的工作提供了一个有前景的范式，能够为策略对话提供有效的过程监督。

articles.title: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models
articles.abstract: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.
articles.titleCn: 一个模型，两条路径：平衡语言模型中的单次通过和循环性能
articles.abstractCn: 重复 Transformer 层可以在不增加参数的情况下提升语言模型的性能。预训练模型可以通过复用中间层权重来支持单次推理和循环推理。由于两条路径共享权重，训练以提升循环预测性能可能会降低单次推理质量。我们研究了使用加权损失在两条输出上进行联合训练的策略，并参考冻结的原始模型进行指导。与仅进行循环训练相比，联合监督显著减少了单次推理质量的下降，同时保留了循环推理相对于普通持续训练的增益。大部分这种优势来自于调整单次推理损失的权重，而参考冻结的原始模型进一步提升了循环推理输出。通过使用验证选择的权重，我们的方法在普通持续训练预定义容差范围内保留了单次推理质量，同时提升了循环推理预测。

articles.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
articles.abstract: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).
articles.titleCn: 吃掉你的精度：精度目标减轻了基于评分标准的强化学习中的奖励黑客
articles.abstractCn: 基于评分标准的奖励机制能够有效促进不可验证任务上的强化学习。然而，由于这些奖励通常被定义为评分标准覆盖率的加权指标，模型主要被训练以最大化召回目标。因此，强化学习训练的模型生成的响应更完整，但也更冗长，包含更多不必要的或事实性错误的内容，导致其不如基础模型的响应受欢迎。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FORK奖励机制，该机制联合优化召回率和一个新颖的精确度目标，该精确度目标要求模型响应的每个单元都必须是必要的且事实正确的，分别通过评分标准驱动的必要性信用和事实正确性评分器进行衡量。我们的实验结果表明，FORK优于现有的基于评分标准的强化学习方法，并实现了平衡评分标准覆盖率和整体响应质量的帕累托最优性能。与原始的基于召回率的奖励机制相比，FORK显著提高了精确度并减少了响应长度，同时实现了相似的评分标准覆盖率，这导致其与基础策略相比的胜率显著提高（例如，在RubricHub-Medical上从10.6%提高到68.0%，在HealthBench上从22.1%提高到74.1%）。

articles.title: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
articles.abstract: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.
articles.titleCn: 面向可学习的文本图问答检索器
articles.abstractCn: 文本图问答（GraphQA）和基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）作为将大型语言模型（LLM）与结构化知识相结合的方式，正受到越来越多的关注。尽管付出了大量努力，现有方法仍然存在两个关键差距。第一个是架构差距：现有方法通常微调基于LLM的生成器，但没有将检索器本身也作为一个可学习的LLM，用于在一个端到端的检索然后生成管道中进行图证据选择。第二个是检索监督差距：现有检索器很少使用黄金答案信号来监督证据选择。因此，它们可能无法回忆推理所需的证据节点，导致黄金答案集的覆盖不足；同时，简单尝试提高召回率往往会引入过多的无关信息，从而损害紧凑性并使LLM不堪重负。为解决这些差距，我们提出了TaLenT，这是一个基于LLM的端到端检索生成框架，用于文本图问答。为弥合架构差距，TaLenT将一个可学习的基于LLM的检索器与一个微调的基于LLM的生成器配对，在一个统一的检索然后生成管道中协同工作。为弥合检索监督差距，我们利用黄金答案信号作为检索器的监督。具体来说，我们将图节点分为黄金答案、答案相关节点和无关噪声。然后，我们采用加权伪标签损失来优先考虑黄金答案，并保留答案相关节点以增强覆盖，同时丢弃无关噪声以保持紧凑性。在三个图问答数据集上的实验结果表明，TaLenT始终如一地提升了下游性能。

articles.title: Novel or Not? PatEx-Gym: Agentic Prior-Art Search for Novelty Assessment in Patent Examination
articles.abstract: Patent examination is a challenging real-world task that requires agents to discover sparse prior art, iteratively refine queries, inspect technical evidence, and produce novelty assessments documented in Office Actions (OAs) across heterogeneous scientific and technical domains. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on static and limited candidate sets, leaving the full search--reasoning--assessment process underexplored. We present PatEx-Gym, the first framework for developing and evaluating agents for patent examination, which integrates three components. First, PatEx-Bench provides 1K realistic examination tasks, two large-scale retrieval corpora containing over 1M patents and 52K scientific papers, and a harness runtime supporting iterative search, document visits, reasoning, and OA generation. Second, we introduce PASS, an annotation-free Prior-Art Agentic Search Trajectory Synthesis framework. Specifically, it exploits document visits as implicit relevance signals and evidence-acquisition anchors to model intra-turn query behavior, inter-turn search progression, and trajectory-level evidence and outcome quality, yielding PatEx-SynData. Third, we train PatEx-Agent at the 4B scale via supervised fine-tuning on the curated trajectories, establishing a lightweight baseline. Extensive experiments show that final decision accuracy alone does not fully reflect examination quality, while prior-art discovery remains difficult even for strong frontier models. Our PatEx-Agent achieves competitive performance against substantially larger general-purpose agents. These results show that training on PatEx-SynData enables a compact 4B model to serve as a competitive baseline for prior-art search and patent examination. We view patent examination as a demanding testbed for agentic search and deep research agents.
articles.titleCn: 小说还是非小说？PatEx-Gym：专利审查中用于新颖性评估的自主先有技术搜索
articles.abstractCn: 专利审查是一项具有挑战性的现实任务，要求代理人员发现稀疏的现有技术，迭代优化查询，检查技术证据，并在异构科学和技术领域生成载于办公行动（OA）中的新颖性评估。然而，现有基准主要关注静态和有限候选集，导致完整的搜索-推理-评估过程尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了PatEx-Gym，这是首个用于开发和评估专利审查代理的框架，它集成了三个组件。首先，PatEx-Bench提供了1K个真实的审查任务、两个包含超过100万项专利和52K篇科学论文的大规模检索语料库，以及一个支持迭代搜索、文档访问、推理和OA生成的执行环境。其次，我们引入了PASS（无标注现有技术代理搜索轨迹合成框架），它利用文档访问作为隐式相关性信号和证据获取锚点来模拟单轮查询行为、多轮搜索进展以及轨迹级证据和结果质量，从而生成PatEx-SynData。第三，我们通过在精选轨迹上进行监督微调，以4B规模训练PatEx-Agent，建立了一个轻量级基线。大量实验表明，仅决策准确率并不能完全反映审查质量，而现有技术发现对于强大的前沿模型仍然困难。我们的PatEx-Agent在显著更大的通用代理面前实现了具有竞争力的性能。这些结果表明，在PatEx-SynData上进行训练能够使一个紧凑的4B模型成为现有技术搜索和专利审查的有竞争力的基线。我们将专利审查视为对代理搜索和深度研究代理的严苛测试平台。

articles.title: Five Architectures, One Shared Space Cross-Model Representational Alignment Without Weight Merging
articles.abstract: Combining language models is usually done by averaging weights, which works only when the models share a common starting point. We ask whether five frozen, independently trained models with different internal designs (four transformers from four organizations and one state-space model) can be related through their activations alone, with no weight merging. Using permutation tests, an independent replication probe set, depth sweeps, pooling ablations and confound checks, we find statistically robust correspondence between how the five models organize the same text. It is strongest at each model's final layer and weaker for the state-space model, whose weakest pairing is still 35-43 times chance. We use this to build a shared space with Generalized Procrustes Analysis, in which no model is a fixed reference. At the final layer, mean held-out retrieval accuracy over the twenty ordered model pairs is 0.91 to 0.93 on two probe sets (chance 0.03), beating pairwise linear maps (0.82 to 0.85), but the space is worse than those maps in the middle layers. It transfers to ordinary English of unfamiliar grammatical form and fails on mathematical and logical notation. We then test whether the space supports a router that picks among the five models on gradeable tasks. Across four task types we find no case where routing beats always using the strongest model, and we report this as a negative result. A correctness signal that looked strong turned out to be category membership in disguise. All experiments ran on one laptop without a GPU.
articles.titleCn: 五座建筑，共享空间跨模型表征对齐无需权重合并
articles.abstractCn: 通常通过平均权重来组合语言模型，但这只有在模型共享相同起点时才有效。我们探究五个冻结的、独立训练且内部设计不同的模型（四个来自不同组织的transformer和一个状态空间模型）是否仅通过其激活就能关联起来，而无需权重合并。通过置换测试、独立复制探测集、深度扫描、池化消融和混杂检查，我们发现这五个模型组织相同文本的方式之间存在统计上稳健的对应关系。这种对应关系在各个模型的最后一层最强，在状态空间模型中较弱，其最弱的配对仍然比随机匹配高出35-43倍。我们利用这种方法通过广义Procrustes分析构建了一个共享空间，其中没有模型作为固定参考。在最后一层，对二十对有序模型平均保留检索准确率在两个探测集上为0.91至0.93（随机匹配为0.03），优于成对线性映射（0.82至0.85），但在中间层，该空间的表现不如这些映射。它能够迁移到不熟悉的语法形式的普通英语，但在数学和逻辑符号上表现不佳。然后我们测试该空间是否支持一个能在可分级任务中从五个模型中选择的路由器。在四种任务类型中，我们没有发现路由器总是优于始终使用最强模型的案例，并将此结果报告为阴性结果。一个看似强烈的正确信号实际上掩盖了类别成员关系。所有实验均在一台没有GPU的笔记本电脑上运行。

articles.title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
articles.abstract: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families. The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.
articles.titleCn: 小规模修改，决策转移：基准测试LLM在法语输入变体上的准确性和可靠性
articles.abstractCn: 法国用户在日常输入中可能会省略撇号和变音符号，或出现键盘输入错误。这些常见变异对语言模型性能和预测可靠性的影响尚未得到充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个包含七种任务类型的受控法语表面变体基准，涵盖4,200组原始-低-高三元组（12,600个输入实例）。每个高强度变体都保留了所有低强度编辑，并增加了进一步的变化。我们评估了来自两个大型语言模型（LLM）系列的六个模型。结果表明，随着扰动强度的增加，准确率下降，而Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）上升。在高压下，较大模型的准确率损失较小，但Brier分数和NLL的增加并不始终随规模减小。键盘输入错误在高强度设置下导致准确率损失最大，并显著影响预测概率的质量。最后，在原始输入上拟合的校准温度能有效迁移到表面变体上。将校准与输入恢复相结合，在单独方法的基础上进一步提高了Brier分数和NLL，同时保持了恢复后的准确率。我们的基准提供了一个统一的框架，用于在常见的法语表面变异下联合评估任务准确率和预测可靠性。

articles.title: Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance
articles.abstract: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting's error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting's total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.
articles.titleCn: LLM 辅导交互对学生表现增量预测价值
articles.abstractCn: 我们评估大型语言模型助教提供的学期级交互特征是否能在常数值基线之上提升作业分数预测的准确性。StudyChat提供了两届本科生人工智能课程中16,851名学生助教交流记录，其结果与203名学生学期记录中的175条匹配。六种拟合估计器和训练折平均与中位数基线共享重复嵌套交叉验证。在十次重复中平均每个学生保留预测后，梯度提升的平均绝对误差为3.023学分点，而中位数基线为3.138。配对差值为-0.114，条件95%自举区间为[-0.245,0.013]。表征变化和特定学期的中位数同样带来微小增益。但在最低分四分位数中，提升误差为7.30分，中位数为8.07分，均值为6.67分；尽管整体误差为3.331，岭回归的拟合模型误差最低，为6.37分。分数集中在上限附近：160名学生（91.4%）得分超过90，最低四分位数贡献了提升总绝对误差的62.1%。这项回顾性比较展示了基线选择和误差分布如何影响预测价值，为评估学生支持工具提供了参考，但并未建立学习效应。

articles.title: Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool
articles.abstract: Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. Together, these design choices enhance the explainability, efficiency, and practical usability of sentence-level propaganda detection in real-world news environments.

articles.titleCn: Propasafe-Hybrid：一种基于文本的混合宣传检测工具
articles.abstractCn: 宣传内容越来越多地通过在线新闻和社交媒体传播，读者往往在这些平台上以有限的审视力接触这些内容，凸显了需要可靠且细粒度的检测手段。本文介绍了Propasafe-Hybrid系统，这是一个基于句子的系统，它将微调的Transformer分类器与基于大型语言模型的技术分类技术相结合，以识别、标记和解释特定的宣传策略。该流程生成可操作的输出，包括高亮句子、技术分配和简洁的理由陈述，使用户能够立即理解为什么某句被标记以及每个标签是如何确定的。为了控制推理成本，Propasafe-Hybrid采用了一种成本感知的预过滤阶段，仅将高可能性句子转发给大型语言模型，从而在保留底层决策逻辑的同时减少token使用。这些设计选择共同提升了在真实新闻环境中进行句子级宣传检测的可解释性、效率和实用性。

articles.title: Adaptive Transfer of Representational Signatures for LLM Reliability Detection
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are reported to be susceptible to reliability issues including hallucinations and reasoning errors. Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. However, training these detectors often requires substantial domain-specific labeled data, which limits their applicability to new domains. We propose to address this challenge by transferring representational signatures across related domains. More specifically, we build a statistical framework that first extracts low-dimensional signatures for each domain, then uses cross-fitting to learn composition weights of domain-specific predictors. The weights adapt to each source domain's predictive relevance to the target domain. Our asymptotic analysis of a least-squares analogue characterizes the limiting prediction risk and aggregation weights in terms of domain discrepancies and representation bias. Experiments across multiple hallucination datasets and open-weight LLMs show that, with only 25 labeled questions in the new domain, adaptive transfer improves hallucination-detection AUROC by 6.8%. For reasoning-step prediction, it improves AUROC by 8.4%.
articles.titleCn: 用于LLM可靠性检测的表征签名自适应迁移
articles.abstractCn: 据报道，大型语言模型（LLMs）容易受到可靠性问题的影响，包括幻觉和推理错误。现有的质量检测器可以根据内部表示以不错的准确率预测不可靠的输出。然而，训练这些检测器通常需要大量特定领域的标注数据，这限制了它们在新领域中的应用。我们提出通过跨相关领域迁移表示特征来应对这一挑战。更具体地说，我们构建了一个统计框架，首先为每个领域提取低维特征，然后使用交叉拟合来学习特定领域预测器的组合权重。这些权重会根据每个源领域对目标领域的预测相关性进行调整。我们对最小二乘法的类似物进行的渐近分析，以领域差异和表示偏差为条件，刻画了极限预测风险和聚合权重。在多个幻觉数据集和开放权重LLMs上的实验表明，在新领域中仅使用25个标注问题，自适应迁移可将幻觉检测的AUROC提高6.8%。对于推理步骤预测，它可将AUROC提高8.4%。

articles.title: Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention
articles.abstract: Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest stories; evaluation is on children's stories vs. technical Wikipedia articles, with pairwise accuracy on contrasts as the primary criterion. Baselines include readability, syntactic/lexical, and LLM-derived measures. SCAPE-T substantially outperforms all tested baselines under word-length control, with a pairwise accuracy of 78.5% (95% bootstrap CI: 76.1-80.4, N=10k pairwise comparisons; +12.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline); without that control, readability heuristics overtake, consistent with their reliance on surface features. On a short-terms abstractness dataset, SCAPE-T also leads. Ablations show each submetric contributes materially. Overall, the results show SCAPE-T isolates conceptual structure from lexical/syntactic confounds better than existing methods, and generalises across two held-out domains.
articles.comment: 12 pages; semantic complexity, complexity estimation, encoder attention, attention analysis, pairwise accuracy, readability, text simplification, transformers
articles.titleCn: 使用SCAPE-T量化意义：编码器仅Transformer注意力的语义复杂性
articles.abstractCn: 在自然语言处理领域，自动化的语义复杂度评估仍处于探索阶段，尽管其在语言学和可解释性方面具有重要应用。本文将语义复杂度定义为唯一指定文本语义意义所需的代码长度，并通过基于注意力机制的编码器仅Transformer模型SCAPE-T进行操作化。现有度量方法要么模拟读者努力（可读性、词汇难度），这与表层特征（词长、句法）相关；要么直接量化表层特征（类型-标记比、词频）。SCAPE-T通过结合三个子度量直接针对语义整合：（i）逆加权自关注（标记到自身）、（ii）CLS关注（标记到CLS），以及（iii）跨头冗余（头之间的余弦相似度），采用层加权聚合；数据驱动学习仅限于超参数调整以进行校准。开发部分使用哲学散文与MCTest故事进行对比；评估部分在儿童故事与技术性维基百科文章上进行，以对比的成对准确率作为主要标准。基线方法包括可读性、句法/词汇度量以及LLM衍生度量。在词长控制下，SCAPE-T显著优于所有测试基线，成对准确率为78.5%（95% bootstrap置信区间：76.1-80.4，N=10k成对比较；比最强基线高12.7个百分点）；未施加控制时，可读性启发式方法反超，这与它们依赖表层特征相符。在短期抽象性数据集上，SCAPE-T同样表现领先。消融实验表明每个子度量均有实质性贡献。总体而言，结果表明SCAPE-T比现有方法更能从词汇/句法干扰中分离出概念结构，并在两个保留域外泛化。

articles.title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
articles.abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.
articles.comment: 10 pages. Preprint submitted to IEEE ICHI 2027. Extends the non-archival GenAI4Health @ NeurIPS 2026 study arXiv:2609.09684v2 with automatic RMS scaling, RSP-Drop, budget analyses, and entropy-prefilter ablations
articles.titleCn: 基于扰动的医疗问答数据选择
articles.abstractCn: 选择一个紧凑的训练子集是适应现有问答库中的医学语言模型的重要步骤。我们研究了基于扰动的数据选择方法，利用从最终块表示的高斯扰动中得到的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转边缘收缩。在共享熵预过滤后，表示敏感性优先级（RSP）通过自动均方根缩放组合这两个信号，而RSP-Drop仅通过收缩对候选进行排序。这两个选择器在筛选过程中仅使用问题和答案选项。我们在MedGemma-4B上使用五个医学QA数据集，在保留集预算为64、128和256个示例的情况下评估它们。在主要的128预算下，RSP和RSP-Drop获得的数据集平均宏观F1分数分别为47.55和48.28，而熵池匹配随机选择的分数为45.11。它们的相对性能在不同数据集和预算下有所变化。一个选定的子集案例研究确定了两种规则交换的示例之间对比鲜明的干净边缘特征，而一个全池消融实验表明，熵预过滤并不总是有益的。这些回顾性结果描述了在固定适应协议下基于扰动选择的经验效用和局限性。评估使用单一主干，并与有记录培训家族重叠的基准进行对比；它并未建立临床有效性。

articles.title: Examining form-based linguistic productivity in people and large language models
articles.abstract: Linguistic productivity, as evidenced by the use of words in novel contexts, is one of the most striking facts about human language. However, how abstract the knowledge that enables such productivity is remains unclear. We compare people's and computational language models' linguistic productivity in contexts where successful generalization depends on form-based information. We focus on extending the use of a novel verb learned in the active voice to passive contexts. We find people extend active to passive uses in a way consistent with abstract generalizations concerning linguistic form, even when no plausible meaning can be assigned to the novel verb. In contrast, large language models succeeded only when a meaning like an existing verb's could be assigned to the novel verb. We conclude that computational models' syntactic knowledge remains tied to the distribution and meaning of specific lexical items in a way that human syntactic knowledge is not.
articles.titleCn: 考察人类和大型语言模型中的基于形式的语言创造性
articles.abstractCn: 语言创造力，体现在词语在全新语境中的运用，是人类语言最引人注目的特征之一。然而，使这种创造力得以实现的知识究竟有多抽象，目前尚不清楚。我们比较了人类与计算语言模型在成功泛化依赖于形式信息语境中的语言创造力。我们重点关注将主动语态中学习的新动词扩展到被动语境中的运用。我们发现，人类在扩展主动语态到被动语态的运用方式上，与关于语言形式的抽象泛化一致，即使对这一新动词无法赋予任何合理的意义。相比之下，大型语言模型只有在能赋予新动词与现有动词相似的意义时才成功。我们得出结论，计算模型的句法知识仍然与特定词汇项的分布和意义紧密相关，而人类的句法知识则并非如此。
